title: PC-CROP Federal Accounting — IntegrationJob pull lease contract
purpose: Stack the next provider-neutral async prerequisite on the external-command contract: exact pull-lease ownership, scoped bearer verification, acknowledgement and one-terminal-result rules for durable IntegrationJob execution. This prevents two connectors/tenants from owning the same lease and prevents an expired or already completed lease from accepting a second business result. No competing queue persistence is created.
boundaries: This slice is stacked on PR #4421 and imports its IntegrationCommandEnvelope validation rather than creating a second idempotency/retry contract.
No IntegrationJob/Outbox/Inbox table is created; durable persistence must extend the existing authority later.
Lease scope is exact tenant + organization + connection + provider partition + machine credential id.
Lease bearer is random; persistent shape stores only salted SHA-256 verifier.
A lease may be acknowledged once and may accept one terminal connector result only.
Expired, revoked/mismatched, wrong-scope or wrong-secret lease is denied.
UNKNOWN_RESULT is never converted to success and is marked reconciliation-required before any retry decision.
A connector-reported success is not Connection Center CONFIRMED_LIVE evidence by itself; external evidence remains a separate authority.
No apps/web, packages, lockfile, Prisma, auth, provider credential, banking, FGIS, hosting or production mutation.
Merge and green CI are not production acceptance.
